manifest.method: Verify production's deployed commit at /api/v1/health equals this checkout, and that the declared implementation commit is an ancestor of it; refuse otherwise, because a boundary tested elsewhere is not the deployed boundary. (A) Run 8 authored write-boundary acceptance cases against the REAL pre-persistence write path on a local instance at that commit — pinned tokenizer suffix refused and the offending member named; bare rosters accepted with and without provenance; declared provenance served back; inverted suffix refused without offering a library version as the encoding; reader-axis precision suffix still accepted; one pinned member among bare ones refused by name; a refused filing leaves the boundary usable. Each failed case counts one. A case that cannot be RUN aborts the run rather than scoring zero. (B) Diff implementation_parent..implementation_commit and count every production path outside the declared validator/OpenAPI surface; test-only paths are not production. (C) Complete a live measurement census reconciled against the served total; a shortfall aborts. C is a precondition and a report, not an addend. value = A + B. File every finite integer, including a non-zero one.
